QuestInfo.name: [Sia Astelle] Source of the Singularity
QuestInfo.0: Isaac suggested that the Memory Keeper in the Temple of Time might be able to help you. You should go look for them.
QuestInfo.1: You learned more about Oort's darkness from the Memory Keeper, and you were even able to find #p9402185#.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered why darkness had fallen upon Oort by using the Heavenly Hours...only to learn that Sirius was in poor condition shortly thereafter. You have no choice but to return to Oort to aid in his recovery.
